about: The non-pet parts of the System Map (system-map-20261012.html): AI models, infrastructure, programs, computers and roadmap pets, plus links that cannot live in pets.json relations because one end is not a pet with a repo. Pet-to-pet links stay in pets.json relations. @pets means every registered and pipeline pet; @seeds and @roadmap mean every seed and every roadmap pet. Links to @pets reach every pet and drawn behind their own toggle. Built by scripts/system-map-20261012.mjs during npm run build. Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), 2026-10-12. Each node has a layer from Astra's architecture chart (0 development, 1 You, 2 Program Manager and Pet Directory, 3 Friendly Farmer, 4 pet agents, 5 AI harness, 6 real programs); each link's colour is the layer it belongs to, worked out in scripts/system-map-20261012.mjs.

nodes.name: The Farm
nodes.job: The Friendly Farmer’s pet program (pet-program-1) and the core of Astra’s PetOS, ring 0: the native home where your pets live and run, organized by the Farmer. It holds the Pet Directory and Program Manager, and its tools are the System Map and Startup Star. Astra’s PetOS is a platform that runs on Windows, not an operating system. Repo: astras-pet-os today; it splits later into the-farm (the app) and astras-pet-os (registry and docs).

nodes.name: The Kennel (community lab)
nodes.job: the-kennel (findastra/the-kennel): the community lab, where other people’s pets are submitted, checked and adopted. Public and outside the harness, like a quarantine pen: a pet from the Kennel never enters anyone’s Farm until it is signed, checked and adopted by that Farm’s owner.

nodes.name: The vet-clinic (community tickets)
nodes.job: Is your pet sick? A public issue tracker on GitHub: a farmer opens a ticket (vet-clinic-ticket-NNNN) with the sick tool’s code and error, after name-eraser and the secret scan; other farmers diagnose it and may offer a cure (a code fix). One tier below Kennel-verified: every community answer carries a warning and never runs by itself; a cure goes through quarantine, a checker agent and the farm’s L4. Every ticket is logged, and cures that work for many farms become official patches (PET-PROGRAM-FRAMEWORK.md, section 10). Outside the harness, like the Kennel.

nodes.name: The Shed (community tools and tricks)
nodes.job: Public, like the Kennel but for tools and tricks made by other creators (findastra/the-shed). Everything there is untrusted until it is quarantined, checked and approved by a farm’s L4. Trust tiers: official, Shed-verified, community (with a warning). Outside the harness.

nodes.name: Program Manager
nodes.job: Neutral registry of every real program: links, launchers, status and capabilities, for every pet including the Farmer (ASTRAS_PET_OS section 6).

nodes.name: AI harness
nodes.job: One layer wrapped around every pet agent, drawn as the glass shell around the pets. It is the standard interface and runtime from the Astra Pet SDK: AI model adapters (Claude, GPT, local), skills and tools, memory, scheduler, inbox, communication, permissions and guardrails. Every pet, the Farmer included, runs its own copy with its own identity, but the design is shared. Pets reach AI models and real programs through it. Planned (ASTRAS_PET_OS sections 7 and 8).

nodes.name: Startup Star
nodes.job: A tool of The Farm (no face, not a pet). The Windows tray Star and the desktop pets that roam your real desktop. Reads pets.json and the art index (scripts/desktop-pets-20261011.cs). Hiding it never stops a pet working.
nodes.label: the-farm-v1.0-startup-star-v1.0

nodes.name: seed-suggester
nodes.label: the-farm-v1.0-seed-suggester-v1.0

Every example pet also offers "Make one like this for me".

nodes.name: Claude (Anthropic)
nodes.job: A cloud farmhand on the allowlist: may take the seat with a short-lived key. Anthropic's models, as a pet's AI model at runtime: pet agents will call Claude on demand through their harness (planned), and Claude Bot's quick chat talks to it.

nodes.name: OpenAI
nodes.job: A cloud farmhand on the allowlist: may take the seat with a short-lived key. OpenAI's models, as a pet's AI model at runtime (planned, through the harness). Today OpenAI image generation is also used by the art pipeline to draw every pet's mood sheet, which is development work, not runtime.

nodes.name: Astra’s local farmhand (in training)
nodes.job: Astra’s own local model, self-hosted on her network. Starts on a short leash (fingerprinted, few grants) and earns trust as it passes Astra’s tests, until she relies on it more than the cloud farmhands. Claude and OpenAI help build it in the meantime. Changed only through Astra.

nodes.name: AI Astra’s mind (local farmhand)
nodes.job: The local model inside VRChat AI Astra (represented by Astra Wisp). Her only avenues: her own pet program (The Astral Plane) and her VRChat body (chatbox drafts today). No files, no keys, no other pets.

Goes in the planned cyberdeck.

nodes.name: Hardware security key
nodes.job: The physical key on your keychain that you tap or plug in to sign in (a FIDO2 or passkey authenticator). It proves it is really you: to your accounts, and later to the Farm and to approvals. ASTRAS_PET_OS lists one in the cyberdeck for hardware-backed sign-in, not as a replacement for encrypted storage, backups or recovery codes.

3.name: Friendly Farmer
3.detail: The independent pet that organizes the pets (intelligent apps) and runs the Farm.

4.name: Individual pet agents
4.detail: Every pet: registered, pipeline, seeds and roadmap. Each runs on its own and talks to the others directly.

5.name: AI harness (per pet)

6.name: Real programs and integrations
6.detail: Real programs: pet programs Astra made sit inside the harness, ring 3, just outside the pets (pink cubes); third-party programs made by others sit outside the harness, ring 5 (peach cubes). Desktop apps, websites, worlds, local files, data sources, cloud services and APIs.
